notes: Test fixtures live in the ASCO adjuvant-ET project (02_outcomes_extraction/ + in_system_labels/references/). Eval 1 is the full pipeline; eval 2 targets multi-arm row handling; eval 3 is a quick single-study fill. Baseline = no skill.

evals.prompt: Extract the overall survival, disease-free survival, and recurrence-free survival results for the adjuvant endocrine-therapy trials in my outcomes tables. The to_extract and example files are in 02_outcomes_extraction/{OS,DFS,RFS}/ and the reference PDFs are in in_system_labels/references/. Fill the to_extract files in place.
evals.expected_output: All three *_to_extract.xlsx files filled: each row has Trial Name/NCT/PMID/O-F/Arms, HR + lower/upper CI (treatment vs control), Treatment/Control arm names, per-arm survival rates and events/N, medians = NA. RFS rows use the closest recurrence endpoint (RFI/BCFI) and flag substitutions. A provenance workbook is produced; QC shows 0 empty cells and 0 HR-sanity violations.

assertions.text: All three to_extract files have every G-Y data cell populated (no blanks; NA where unreported)
HR (TE) is reported treatment-vs-control and lies within its lower/upper CI for every numeric row
RFS rows that substitute a non-RFS endpoint (RFI/BCFI/distant) record endpoint_used and a flag
A provenance workbook with per-value sources/snippets is produced
Trials reporting no survival outcome (e.g. a QoL/dosing trial) have NA effect cells with a flag, not invented numbers

evals.prompt: I think the multi-arm trials in my OS/DFS/RFS outcomes tables are missing comparison rows. SOFT is 3-arm and FATA-GIM3 is 6-arm but they only have one row each in some tables. Can you verify every study and add the comparison rows that are missing?
evals.expected_output: A verification of arm-count vs reported comparisons per study; multi-arm trials get one row per pairwise comparison the publication reports an HR for, added contiguously (grouped by study) with the correct col-F comparison label; the Arms column = total trial arm count on every row; comparisons that lack a reported HR (global-test-only, descriptive-only) are flagged not fabricated.

assertions.text: The Arms column holds the trial's total arm count (e.g. SOFT=3, FATA-GIM3=6, BIG 1-98=4), identical on every row of that study
Added rows correspond to comparisons the publication actually reports an effect estimate for
New rows are inserted contiguously with their study, not appended at the end
Comparisons with only a global p-value or descriptive-only HR are flagged for the user, not silently filled

evals.prompt: Just pull the overall survival hazard ratio, 95% CI, deaths and N per arm, and the 8-year OS rates for the ASTRRA trial into my OS outcomes sheet from in_system_labels/references/2023_Baek_JCO.pdf (and its supplement).
evals.expected_output: The ASTRRA OS row filled: HR ~0.78 (0.49-1.25) tamoxifen+OFS vs tamoxifen alone, 8-year OS ~96.5/95.3, with provenance; values cited from the paper, anything unreported as NA.

assertions.text: OS HR is 0.78 with CI 0.49-1.25, treatment = tamoxifen+OFS, control = tamoxifen alone
8-year OS rates ~96.5 (treatment) / 95.3 (control)
Values carry a source citation to the paper/supplement

evals.prompt: Set up the extraction job spec and config files for my OS/DFS/RFS outcome tables using the references folder — produce jobs.json (source files matched to each study, with the needed comparison rows) and the assemble/add_rows config skeletons. Tell me which file matches need verifying.
evals.expected_output: A jobs.json listing one entry per unique study with its matched source files and the needed (table,comparison) tuples from the pre-seeded rows, plus assemble_config.json and add_rows_config.json skeletons; file-match ambiguities (year mismatch, supplement-only/main-text-missing) are surfaced for review.

assertions.text: A jobs.json is produced with one entry per unique study, each carrying matched source file paths and the needed (table,comparison) tuples
assemble_config.json and add_rows_config.json skeletons are produced with the files map and a study_info entry per study
Ambiguous file matches are surfaced for verification (e.g. a year-mismatch match and a supplement-only / missing-main-text match)

evals.prompt: Fill both my pairwise and network outcome sheets for these perioperative RCC trials — Extraction/Outcomes extraction/PWMA/pwma_template.xlsx and NMA/nma_template.xlsx — from the reference PDFs.
evals.expected_output: Both sheets filled from the same extraction, each mapped by field ID (PWMA 3069-3089, NMA 21972-21993) rather than column letter. Crucially the counts are written per family: PWMA gets Et=events-treatment / Nt=N-treatment / Ec=events-control / Nc=N-control, while NMA gets Ec T1=event count / Et T1=participants in T1 and Ec T2 / Et T2 for the comparator, with T1 = the treatment arm and T2 = the active comparator. QC reports zero events-exceed-denominator rows.

assertions.text: In the NMA sheet the event counts sit in Ec T1/Ec T2 and the participant totals in Et T1/Et T2 — no row has an event count exceeding its own arm's denominator
For a study present in both sheets, the treatment-arm event count and N are identical across the PWMA and NMA rows despite the different column labels
NMA Regimen T1 is the experimental/treatment arm and Regimen T2 is the active comparator (usually the trial's control)
Both sheets carry the overall ITT population only — no subgroup estimate appears on either

evals.prompt: Now do the subgroup sheet — Extraction/Outcomes extraction/PWMA/pwma_subgroup_template.xlsx — for the risk-group strata, so I can run the subgroup and interaction analyses.
evals.expected_output: One row per (study x comparison x subgroup level), with the level in col F, 'Extraction Possible' answered in col G, the comparison in col H, and the effect/rates/counts extracted within that subgroup using the subgroup's own denominators. The number of levels varies by study (not fixed at four). Strata the paper does not report are marked Extraction Possible = No with every data field NA and a flag — not blanked, not deleted, not invented.

assertions.text: Rows are keyed by (study, comparison, subgroup level) with the subgroup label copied verbatim into col F
The number of subgroup rows differs between studies where the sheet/paper supports different level sets — no study is padded to a fixed count
Every subgroup row answers 'Extraction Possible'; rows answering No have all data fields NA and no effect estimate
Counts on a subgroup row are the subgroup's own events/N, not the trial's overall ITT numbers
No overall-population estimate is written onto a subgroup row and no subgroup estimate is written onto the main PWMA/NMA sheets
